newsitem.title: GERMANY: INTERVIEW-Viag CEO says BT link very strong.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Viag CEO says BT link very strong.

text.p: Viag AG chairman Georg Obermeier said on Friday that the group's telecoms partnership with British Telecom was very strong and was continually improving.
Obermeier told Reuters in an interview after the release of 1996 business data: "The relationship with British Telecom is very strong and keeps getting better."
He also said that Viag's Computer 2000 unit reached break-even in 1996.
Asked whether market estimates for Viag's 1996 earnings per share of between 36 and 38 marks were realistic, Obermeier said they were "not out of line."
Obermeier also said Viag did not plan any further capital increases for its telecommunications business.

Asked to comment on recent speculation that rival utility Veba AG was in discussions with British Telecom, Obermeier said, "Everyone is talking to everyone else. This is an ongoing process and this happens all the time."
Viag earlier announced an increase in operating profit before tax to just under 2.4 billion marks in 1996 from 2.1 billion marks the previous year.
Sales rose to about 42.5 billion marks from 41.9 billion, Viag said.
